# Galaxy-Digital

> A UAE-based, consultancy-first cloud-native MSP. We build sovereign Red Hat OpenShift private clouds, automate their Day-2 operations with agentic AIOps, and transform how teams work — AI-native by design. Senior-only delivery (Red Hat Certified Architects and ex-Red Hat engineers); no offshore handoff.

Tagline: Sovereign private cloud. Autonomous operations. AI-native by design.
Based in: United Arab Emirates. Serves: Middle East, Africa, Europe.
Contact: hello@galaxy-digital.ae · +971 50 771 0305

## What we do

Four pillars on one cloud-native substrate:
- Platform Engineering — sovereign OpenShift private cloud, GitOps, golden paths.
- Agentic Operations — autonomous Day-2 operations across six ops domains, with human-set intent and guardrails.
- AI Transformation — people and process change so teams work AI-natively.
- Security — secure-by-default platform and workloads.

Hosting is an optional add-on; the engagement is consultancy and custom implementation first.
